headline: Berger Paints Nigeria 9M Pre-Tax Profit Rises 14.8% to N1.68 Billion
summary: Berger Paints Nigeria Plc recorded a 14.8% rise in profit before tax to N1.68 billion for the first nine months of the year, up from N1.46 billion, and declared a dividend.
why: Berger Paints Nigeria is a major manufacturer listed on the Nigerian Exchange, reflecting manufacturing margins amid inflation and currency fluctuations.
